not really tense. more like. worn down i guess but theres a thing underneath it. i found out today my best friend had a whole birthday dinner and didnt invite me
That sounds hurt, with a worn-down layer on top. Was the hardest part the exclusion itself, or what it seemed to say about you?
what it says about me probably. like i saw the photos on instagram. everyone was there. people i introduced HER to. and im just. not on the list anymore i guess
That sounds like a sharp kind of left-out hurt — seeing the photos, and then the thought of not being on the list anymore. Did it make you want to pull back, or go quiet?
go quiet. i already did. she texted me happy something meme thing yesterday like nothing and i just left her on read. ten years we been friends. i was at her dads funeral. i dont get it

no i want to stay with it. cause heres the thing i keep going back and forth. part of me is so angry. but the other part is like. did i do something. was i too much lately. ive been a mess since my mom got sick and maybe shes just done with me being heavy
I’m hearing anger and also a self-blame kind of wobble — like maybe you’re wondering if being “heavy” pushed her away. Does that fit, or is it more about fearing you were too much?

yeah the too much thing. like i called her crying twice last month about my mom. and she was nice about it but maybe she didnt mean it. maybe everyone has a limit and i hit hers and now im the friend you dont invite anymore

i dont know. saying it out loud it sounds like im making the dinner mean the worst possible thing. like i jumped straight to im unlovable instead of maybe she planned it weird or forgot or i dunno. doesnt make the hurt go away tho

the fear of what it says about me. thats the loud one. the left out part stings but i can sit with that. its the what if everyone leaves when im hard to love that keeps me up. anyway. maybe ill actually text her back and just ask instead of spiraling

lets leave it here. im tired but a bit less knotted up than i was. thanks for letting me ramble. gonna go text her back before i lose my nerve
